Name: (FS) Kat's Wings
Author: katriex
Description:
[center][b][color=#ea9999][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/color][size=4]﻿[/size][/b][/center][center]Hello! This is my first ever Fashion Sense mod!
It adds 8 sets of wings as accessories. None are colorable, but they come in white, black, and red, depending on the type![/center]
[b][color=#ea9999][center][size=4]INSTALLATION[/size][size=4]﻿ & USE[/size][/center][/color][/b][center]1. Download SMAPI and Fashion Sense if you haven't already.
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip into your mods folder.
4. Load the game, then use the mirror item[size=2](purchasable from Pierre if you haven't already received/otherwise obtained it)[/size] to access the Fashion Sense menu!
5. In the Accessories menu, go through the options until you find these wings!
Then enjoy! I'd love to see outfits anyone makes with these.

Note: The wings are all drawn in front of the hair, even on the back side, for visibility. If you want the back view to go behind hair, you can edit any accessory.json where you find the "BackAccessory"'s "DrawBeforeHair" option and change it to false instead of true.
[/center]
